Event TableColorItem.Click
&WWP_DesignSystemSettings = WWP_GetDesignSystemSettings() &WWP_DesignSystemSettings.BaseColor = &ColorName SaveUserKeyValue(!"DesignSystemSettings", &WWP_DesignSystemSettings.ToJson()) GeneXus.Common.UI.DesignSystem.SetOption(!"base-color", &WWP_DesignSystemSettings.BaseColor) FSColor.Refresh() WWPActions.EmpoweredGrids_Refresh()
EndEvent
Event FontSizeSmall.Click
&FontSizeSelected = !"Small" Do 'SelectFont' Do 'UpdateSelectedFont'
EndEvent
Event FontSizeMedium.Click
&FontSizeSelected = !"Medium" Do 'SelectFont' Do 'UpdateSelectedFont'
EndEvent
Event FontSizeLarge.Click
&FontSizeSelected = !"Large" Do 'SelectFont' Do 'UpdateSelectedFont'
EndEvent
Event &BackStyle.ControlValueChanged
&WWP_DesignSystemSettings = WWP_GetDesignSystemSettings() &WWP_DesignSystemSettings.BackgroundStyle = &BackStyle GeneXus.Common.UI.DesignSystem.SetOption(!"background-color", &WWP_DesignSystemSettings.BackgroundStyle) &WWP_DesignSystemSettings.MenuColor = &BackStyle GeneXus.Common.UI.DesignSystem.SetOption(!"menu-color", &WWP_DesignSystemSettings.MenuColor) SaveUserKeyValue(!"DesignSystemSettings", &WWP_DesignSystemSettings.ToJson()) WWPActions.EmpoweredGrids_Refresh()
EndEvent
Sub 'GetColorClass'
&ColorItemBaseClass = !'RuntimeSettingsColor' &ColorItemClass = IIF(&WWP_DesignSystemSettings.BaseColor = &ColorName, &ColorItemBaseClass + !"Selected", &ColorItemBaseClass)
EndSub
Sub 'SelectFont'
&WWP_DesignSystemSettings = WWP_GetDesignSystemSettings() &WWP_DesignSystemSettings.FontSize = &FontSizeSelected SaveUserKeyValue(!"DesignSystemSettings", &WWP_DesignSystemSettings.ToJson()) GeneXus.Common.UI.DesignSystem.SetOption(!"font-size", &WWP_DesignSystemSettings.FontSize) WWPActions.EmpoweredGrids_Refresh()
EndSub
Sub 'UpdateSelectedFont'
&FontSizeSelected = &WWP_DesignSystemSettings.FontSize
FontSizeSmall.Class = StyleClass:FontSizeSelectorSmall FontSizeMedium.Class = StyleClass:FontSizeSelectorMedium FontSizeLarge.Class = StyleClass:FontSizeSelectorLarge Do Case
Case &FontSizeSelected = !"Small" FontSizeSmall.Class = FontSizeSmall.Class + " " + StyleClass:FontSizeSelectorSelected Case &FontSizeSelected = !"Medium" FontSizeMedium.Class = FontSizeMedium.Class + " " +StyleClass:FontSizeSelectorSelected Case &FontSizeSelected = !"Large" FontSizeLarge.Class = FontSizeLarge.Class + " " + StyleClass:FontSizeSelectorSelected EndCase
EndSub
